children.name: Twitch Helix Streams API
children.details: Syncs live streamers every 30-45s, fetches avatars, titles, viewer counts, and recent VODs

children.name: FiveM Server Status API
children.details: Queries /dynamic.json or CFX endpoint for player count (124/128) and ping

children.name: Discord Live Webhooks
children.details: Delivers rich embeds with roleplay character name, faction, and Tebex store codes

children.name: Tebex Store & Code Tracker
children.details: Tracks watch clicks, code copies, and store visits per streamer

children.name: Live Hub & 3D Streamer Marquee
children.details: Real-time viewer numbers, live previews, and interactive cards

children.name: Multi-Stream Squad Grid
children.details: Watch 1 to 4 streams side-by-side with synced audio switching and Twitch chat

children.name: Los Santos Interactive Map
children.details: Map of Mission Row, Pillbox Hill, DOJ Courthouse with faction live streamer pins

children.name: Community Clips Portal
children.details: Viewer clip submission, category filtering (Chase, Heist, etc.), and upvotes

children.name: Server Event Schedule
children.details: Court trials, spray wars, car showcases with add-to-calendar integration

children.name: PWA & Push Notifications
children.details: Web app manifest, offline service worker cache, and stream alert toasts

children.name: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
children.details: Real-time sync broadcast over /api/events for immediate UI refresh without reload

children.name: Admin Auth & JWT Session
children.details: Bcrypt hashed passwords, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies, role-based access

children.name: Audit Logging & Security
children.details: Tracks all admin actions with timestamp, user ID, and entity metadata

children.name: JSON File DB (/data/pioneer_live.json)
children.details: Atomic async writes with debounced persistence and automated seed restore

children.name: Vercel Postgres / Neon / Supabase
children.details: Auto-detected via DATABASE_URL / POSTGRES_URL with automatic table creation

children.name: Full JSON & CSV Export / Restore
children.details: Instant backup download, file restore, and audit CSV exports from Admin Settings
